howToPlay: Use the third kick to push enemies back and ignite them while controlling the map with your mosh pit super. Utilize the wall of sound gadget to block paths or spiritual healing to support teammates. Focus on stunning enemies by knocking them into walls with your crowdkill star power.
gears: Equip the speed gear to maneuver around the battlefield more effectively. The health gear is ideal for staying in the fight longer, and the damage gear increases your impact when health is low.
trait: This brawler is perfect for aggressive players who enjoy controlling the tempo of the fight and disrupting enemy positioning.
